limitations: This SDRF covers the eight glycopeptide RAW files only. The other 15 RAW files represent released glycans or in-depth proteomics and require separate annotations or an applicable glycomics schema.

The article gives 120 N-glycan compositions as variable search modifications but the exact composition list is outside this manifest. Modification parameters are omitted to avoid an incomplete glycan search specification.
The cell line donor's disease status is not explicitly given; the permitted 'not available' value is used.
Cellosaurus identifies N/TERT-1 as CVCL_CW92, but the cached CLO/BTO/EFO ontology set used by parse_sdrf does not recognize its cell-line name; official validation emits a cell-line warning.
The two source names identify prepared TCL and surface sample groups from the same cell line; biological replicate 1 is the sole reported source ordinal, while 01 and 02 are technical measurements.
